notes.g-agree-01: New stem: plural head 'The projectors' with the singular 'every conference room on the fourth floor' right before the blank, pulling toward 'has'. Options reordered (have / has / having / to have) so the key stays A. Level 1 -> 2. I did not use the calibrator's 'Each of the conference rooms ...' because a plural verb after 'each of + plural' is accepted informally by some usage guides, and because it nearly repeats the reference page example.
notes.g-pronoun-01: Stem and key (B = its) unchanged; the contraction option it's was replaced by theirs. I rejected their because 'Venlow Logistics has updated their return policy' is acceptable in informal and British usage. Point, why, wrong, zh and vocab rewritten. Level 1.
notes.g-parallel-02: New stem: the correlative partner 'nor' is now ten words after the blank, and the nearer 'sales and marketing' puts an 'and' in view that pulls toward 'both'. Options and key (A = neither) unchanged. Level 2.
notes.g-parallel-03: New stem: coordinated verbs share 'must' (must register ... and keep), with the partner ten words back; 'of purchase and ___' makes 'keeping' look right. Answer is now a base form, not Ving. Key stays C. Level 2.
